About 100 grams

100 g is the standard unit on nutrition labels and in metric recipes, so it's handy to know what it looks like in cups.

Grams measure weight and cups measure volume, so there's no single answer to how many cups 100 g is. A cup of flour weighs 120 g and a cup of sugar 200 g, so the same 100 g fills a different amount of cup for each. Find your ingredient in the chart, or pick it in the converter above.

Questions

How many cups is 100 grams of all-purpose flour?

100 g of all-purpose flour is about ⅞ cup, based on 120 g per cup.

How many cups is 100 grams of granulated sugar?

100 g of granulated sugar is ½ cup, based on 200 g per cup.

How many cups is 100 grams of butter?

100 g of butter is about ½ cup, based on 227 g per cup.
